license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable transcription of the official CCC2020 CC BY3.0 publication, article17 pp17:1--17:22. One main preprocessing lower-bound mechanism: original formal Theorem9, full Section2 definitions/standard prerequisites3--8, original Proposition10 and complete author proof plus inner-product Corollaries11--12, and full Section5 Proposition18/Lemma19/Theorem9 proofs retained. The projection lemma includes all averaging, Markov, coefficient, orthonormal-basis and constant13 calculations and original footnote. Main proof includes complete permutation extension, every completion/agreement argument, full two-slice inner-product expansion, and low-degree projection/spectral concentration conclusion. All36 original bibliography entries retained. Main arbitrary separate preprocessing, short Bob output n+k, constant depth/size bounds and IP implications are unchanged. Original printed wording/notation is preserved rather than mathematically repaired: Theorem9 right one-to-one premise versus proofSTEP1 left wording; STEP2 printed vector codomain; printed y_(n+i) positions; Proposition10 displayed expectation inequality; original k=0 range/final ratios. No added hypotheses or independent correctness claim. The author-standard external LMNT/entropy statements retained without recursive reproof. The2024 journal57-page version was retrieved but its added correlation results are not mixed into this item; exact published CCC proof is complete. Conditional learning/cryptographic/rounded-IP applications are outside this item and not separately counted. No source-native TeX was found in bounded lookup, so the licensed formal PDF/text was faithfully transcribed. No figures required. Root handles compilation/database/publication.

core_obligations: Preserve exact separate-preprocessing/SMP model and arbitrary A/B functions, Bob output n+k and referee depth/size restrictions.
Retain precise near-orthogonality/subset cardinality/one-to-one premises and full formal9 proof.
Retain full Proposition18 and ProjectionLemma19 author reasoning, not just bounds or formulas.
Retain full Proposition10 deduction and inner-product11/12 consequences together, without counting parameter/support branches separately.
difficulty_reason: The author extends short encodings to cube permutations and completes partially specified slices with parity fillers to preserve pairwise near-orthogonality while retaining circuit agreement. A quantitative projection lemma then forces one slice away from the low-degree subspace, where LMNT yields the depth/size lower bound. These are explicit nonroutine mechanisms.
